# Per-core Kconfig fragment for slice `m33_sm` (zephyr).

CONFIG_ALP_SDK=y
CONFIG_LOG=y
CONFIG_PRINTK=y
CONFIG_THREAD_LOCAL_STORAGE=y
CONFIG_LOG_DEFAULT_LEVEL=3

# Boot-banner SoC identity + system summary (from the SoC spec JSON + SoM preset `memory:`; see alp_banner.c).
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_SOC_NAME="Renesas RZ/V2N R9A09G056N44GBG"
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_SOC_CPUS="Cortex-M33 @200MHz (active)|cm33 + 4x Cortex-A55 @1800MHz"
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_SOC_NPUS="Drp-Ai"
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_SOC_SRAM_KB=1536
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_SOM_DRAM_MBIT=32768
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_SOM_FLASH_MBIT=32768

# On-module HW manifest EEPROM -> portable bus 0 (alp-i2c0);
# enables alp_hw_info_read() + the console banner manifest line.
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_HW_INFO_EEPROM_I2C_BUS_ID=0

CONFIG_ALP_SDK_SOM_HW_REV="2625-r2"

# SoM silicon (renesas:rzv2n:n44 via E1M-V2N101)
CONFIG_ALP_SOC_RENESAS_RZV2N_N44=y

# Cross-EVK board facade selector (<alp/board.h>); CONFIG_COMPILER_OPT is single-value (do not also set in prj.conf).
CONFIG_COMPILER_OPT="-DALP_BOARD_E1M_X_EVK"

# SoM-intrinsic chip drivers (from `E1M-V2N101` on_module + helper_firmware)
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_ACT8760=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_CLK_5L35023B=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_DA9292=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_EEPROM_24C128=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_GD32G553=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_MURATA_LBEE5HY2FY=y

CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_RTL8211FDI=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_RV3028C7=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_TMP112=y

# Board-populated chip drivers (from the resolved board definition)
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_BME280=n
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_BMI323=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_BMP581=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_BLOCK_BUTTON_LED=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_CAM_MUX_PI3WVR626=n
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_ICM42670=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_INA228=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_INA236=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_LIS2DW12=n
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_LSM6DSO=n
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_OV5640=n
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_BLOCK_PDM_MIC=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_SSD1306=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_SSD1331=n
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_TAS2563=y
CONFIG_ALP_SDK_CHIP_TCAL9538=y

# Zephyr subsystems required on core `m33_sm` (chip drivers + peripherals)
CONFIG_GPIO=y
CONFIG_I2C=y
CONFIG_SPI=y

/*
 * Auto-generated by scripts/alp_project.py -- do not edit by hand.
 * Regenerate after changes to board.yaml.
 *
 * Build-time identifier companion to <alp/hw_info.h>.  Apps include
 * this header alongside <alp/hw_info.h> and pass the ALP_HW_BUILD_*
 * string macros to alp_hw_info_assert_matches_build() so the runtime
 * EEPROM read can be checked against what the firmware was built for.
 */

#ifndef ALP_HW_INFO_BUILD_H
#define ALP_HW_INFO_BUILD_H

#define ALP_HW_BUILD_SOM_SKU         "E1M-V2N101"
#define ALP_HW_BUILD_SOM_FAMILY      "v2n"
#define ALP_HW_BUILD_SOM_HW_REV      "2625-r2"
#define ALP_HW_BUILD_BOARD_NAME      "E1M-X-EVK"
#define ALP_HW_BUILD_BOARD_HW_REV    "r1"
#define ALP_HW_BUILD_OS              "zephyr"

#define ALP_HW_BUILD_CORES           "m33_sm"
#define ALP_HW_BUILD_PRIMARY_CORE    "m33_sm"

/* Per-core presence flags: `ALP_HW_BUILD_HAS_<id>` means core <id> exists in
 * the project; its value is that core's OS string.  Defined for EVERY active
 * core in EVERY slice -- it cannot say which core is compiling.
 *
 * `ALP_HW_BUILD_PRIMARY_CORE` names the compiling slice ONLY when this header
 * was emitted --core-scoped (the per-slice build path).  Emitted without
 * --core -- as the project-wide recipe in docs/board-config-emit.md does -- it
 * names the project's primary core (first M-class core alphabetically),
 * which on a multi-core project is not necessarily the one you are
 * building.
 *
 * Zephyr's own CONFIG_BOARD and CONFIG_BOARD_TARGET differ per slice too --
 * the board name and the board/soc/cpucluster target passed to `west build
 * -b` -- and do so no matter how this header was emitted.  E.g. on E1M-AEN801,
 * the HE slice's CONFIG_BOARD is "alp_e1m_aen801_m55_he" and its
 * CONFIG_BOARD_TARGET ends ".../rtss_he"; the HP slice's end "_hp" and
 * ".../rtss_hp".  Prefer them over PRIMARY_CORE where that portability
 * matters. */
#define ALP_HW_BUILD_HAS_M33_SM       "zephyr"

#endif /* ALP_HW_INFO_BUILD_H */

# Regenerate after changes to board.yaml's `libraries:` array.
#
# Import into your application's west.yml so `west update`
# pulls only the Zephyr modules the libraries you enabled

manifest:
  projects:
    - name: zephyr
      import:
        name-allowlist:
          # no selected Zephyr-owned modules -- nothing to allowlist.
          []
